baseline: OpenAI Codex agents with local source search/read; no OpenRouter; not ChatGPT web
metric: One-to-one match on file and line (+/-2), without operation-name validation. Unmatched predictions are ungraded.
reference_limit: Botocore-pattern reference regenerated after the prior temporary corpus was removed. Commits below identify the restored corpus. Counts match the earlier snapshot, but its full hashes were unavailable. RISE coverage used a scanner-rule check. Repositories were preselected for zero unaccounted candidates, so this is not an independent or representative estimate of RISE recall.

timed_subset.method: Five local scanner runs per repository; sum of medians, input already loaded. OpenAI lower bound from an observation during the active batch until its JSON output was written. Agent interval includes search, model inference and writing the output. Neither timing includes checkout.
